archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) blended with Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast)
design_philosophy: A modern Indian SaaS that feels like a 'Sathi' (companion). Grounded warm tones with sharp, high-contrast typography. Avoids the cold 'tech-bro' blue/purple aesthetics. Emphasizes clarity, fast F-pattern scanning, progressive disclosure, and bento-box layouts.

rules: Headings must use tight letter spacing.
Never center text by default; use intentional left-alignment for dense content.
Use 'Outfit' for all prominent numbers and headings to give a geometric, modern tech feel.
Do not use generic fonts like Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more padding than usual for breathing room.
rules: Always use mobile-first grid columns (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3/4/8/12).
Card containers must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision with borders.
Section vertical spacing should use py-20 or py-32.

navigation.classes: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-border shadow-sm

buttons.primary: bg-[#E05D3A] text-white hover:bg-[#C84B29] transition-colors rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium
buttons.secondary: bg-[#1A2A42] text-white hover:bg-[#111C2D] transition-colors rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium
buttons.outline: border-2 border-[#EAE6DF] text-primary hover:border-[#1A2A42] transition-colors rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium
buttons.ghost: text-secondary hover:text-primary hover:bg-black/5 transition-colors rounded-full px-4 py-2

language_toggle.description: A prominent but subtle toggle switch in the header to flip between 'English' and 'Hinglish'. Must have active state clearly highlighted with #E05D3A.

hero_section.description: Left-aligned heavy text with bilingual toggle near heading. Right side features a floating 3D mascot or abstract Bento UI overlapping the background.

playground_dashboard.style: Cardless or flat cards with 1px border. Deep dense spacing to contrast the airy marketing layout. Uses 'IBM Plex Sans' for data density.

rules: Always use Shadcn UI components for complex interactions (Dropdown, Tabs, Forms).
Do NOT use raw HTML <select> or <input type='date'>.
Every interactive element MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., 'data-testid="hero-cta-button"').

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: All buttons must translate slightly (-translate-y-0.5) and have clear color contrast changes.
motion_and_interaction.transitions: Use specific properties: 'transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease'.
motion_and_interaction.scroll: Implement 'lenis' for smooth scrolling to give a premium feel.
motion_and_interaction.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. High contrast focus rings mandatory.

hero_background.alt: Abstract textured background with warm terracotta and deep indigo
hero_background.usage: Behind the hero section with low opacity (e.g. 10-20%)

mascot_3d.usage: Hero section primary visual on the right or floating

bento_abstract.usage: Features section or 'How it works' visual

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST read and apply all colors, fonts, and rules from this JSON exactly as specified.
Do NOT use Inter font or purple/violet/teal color gradients.
Implement a working toggle for English/Hinglish in the Header.
Ensure the hero section overlay does not exceed bg-white/40 to let the background breathe.
Build the dashboard/playground section using Shadcn components (cards, tabs, inputs) but style them with our specific border radii, colors, and 1px borders.
All interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
Import Outfit and IBM Plex Sans fonts globally.
Never use generic placeholder images; only use the image URLs provided in the media section of this JSON.
